name: Embrace The Chaos
description:
Whenever a combatant within short range takes damage from a source other than you, you gain a chaos token. On your turn, you may spend chaos tokens to gain +1d each on skill checks.

Unused tokens are lost at the end of your turn—unless you hit and deal damage. If you do, you may pass any remaining tokens to any number of creatures within short range. Recipients must use these tokens on their next turn or lose them.

Describe how you turn the chaos of battle to your advantage.

improvements.name: Bloodlust
improvements.description: Once per round, you may spend one chaos token to add a bonus die to a damage roll instead of a skill check. Bonus dice you pass to others can still only be used on skill checks.

improvements.name: Chaos Reigns
improvements.description: You also gain chaos tokens for damage dealt to combatants within medium range.

improvements.name: Love A Good Fight
improvements.description: You can exchange chaos tokens to gain a d12 engagement die for your next engagement. Tokens you pass to others can still only be used on skill checks.
